steps.title: Diagnose AAPT Resource Linking Error
steps.description: Identify invalid Android platform style Theme.Material.NoTitleBar.Fullscreen in AndroidManifest and styles.xml.

steps.title: Fix Game Theme Style Declaration
steps.description: Update GameTheme to extend valid @android:style/Theme.Material with fullscreen window flags.

steps.title: Update Application Manifest
steps.description: Apply @style/GameTheme to application tag and remove obsolete package attribute to comply with AGP 8.3.2 namespace rules.

steps.title: Clean Dependencies in Gradle Script
steps.description: Remove unnecessary third-party nanohttpd dependency from app/build.gradle and ensure native-only compilation.

steps.title: Verify Audio and Haptic Feedback System
steps.description: Ensure ToneGenerator and Vibrator mechanics operate properly under the corrected theme context.

steps.title: Validate Particle Rendering Pipeline
steps.description: Confirm particle pool physics calculations and alpha fading routines.

steps.title: Verify Slice Trail Segment Collision
steps.description: Confirm swipe trail decay and circle intersection collision checks remain optimized.

steps.title: Verify Fruit Geometry and Cutting Logic
steps.description: Ensure slicing angle separation forces and half-fruit rendering calculate accurately.

steps.title: Validate Game SurfaceView Loop
steps.description: Check thread synchronization, touch event delegation, score tracking, and HUD drawing.

steps.title: Verify Immersive Activity Lifecycle
steps.description: Ensure MainActivity sticky immersive mode operates cleanly with the newly defined Theme.Material parent.

steps.title: Building Slice Master
steps.description: Compile, package, link resources, and build the APK release artifact.
